prompt:
Create a polished pixel-aware hand painted game GROUND MATERIAL sprite sheet for a central European transport simulation. Genuine transparent PNG background, exactly a 3 columns by 3 rows evenly spaced grid, nine isolated tiles, no labels or text, no border, no checkerboard. Camera is STRICTLY FLAT VERTICAL ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP DOWN, no perspective, no tilted diamond, no raised buildings, no cast shadows outside cells, no horizon. These are ground textures later projected by a game engine, so all shapes must remain rectangles seen from directly above. Cohesive warm natural palette, realistic granular material detail that reads at 32 px, art like high quality classic transport sim, subtle wear and careful restrained detail.

Within every cell leave at least 6% genuinely transparent padding around sprite. Every strip in cells 1-4 runs exactly north-south (vertical), is a straight evenly wide strip with no bend, no tapered ends, no circular end cap, no scene props. Strip length 86% of cell height, width about 40% of cell width, squared-off top and bottom with seamless equal-looking material at both ends. Colors near corresponding old transport art: asphalt medium neutral grey, shoulders tan grey, track ballast muted brown/grey. NO GREEN BACKGROUND RECTANGLES around strips.

Read rows left to right:
ROW 1:
1. A long straight two-lane asphalt road strip, finely mottled weathered grey asphalt with tiny aggregate, subtle patched wear, restrained narrow faded pale dashed center line (dash 10% of strip length, equal gaps), slightly darker wheel tracks, tan compact gravel verges along both sides, a few tiny moss/grass flecks at outside shoulder only. No sidewalk, no vehicles.
2. A long straight single railway track strip, two exact parallel shining subdued steel rails, many evenly spaced dark warm wooden sleepers, sharply detailed granular limestone and grey-brown ballast shoulder, tiny rusty rail fastenings, no wires, no poles, no trains.
3. A long straight two-lane road BRIDGE DECK SURFACE strip from direct top down, same asphalt and dash line as first road, but narrow weathered concrete curbs and narrow flat dark steel edge strips, subtle regular expansion joints. No columns, no structure perspective, no supports beyond the strip.

ROW 2:
4. A long straight single railway BRIDGE DECK SURFACE strip from direct top down, parallel steel rails and dark sleepers, compact rust-grey ballast over flat dark steel deck, narrow steel guard edges, tiny regular riveting. No girders protruding, no supporting columns.
5. An isolated SQUARE unmarked asphalt pavement patch, weathered medium grey asphalt aggregate, fine irregular hairline cracks, very subtle wheel scuffing, neutral color matching the road pavement, no lines or curb or stones around perimeter. This is road junction material, flat opaque square with exact horizontal and vertical edges.
6. An isolated SQUARE neutral railway ballast ground patch, tightly packed natural brown-grey angular gravel and a few small cinders, subtle believable aggregate variation, no rails or sleepers, no border. Square exact horizontal and vertical edges.

ROW 3:
7. A vacant RESIDENTIAL building plot surface: isolated exact square of warm fresh muted green lawn with very fine short grass tufts and irregular patches of soil, a few worn footpaths barely visible, pleasant restrained light yellow-green character. NO fencing, roads, trees, buildings, signs, markings or icons. Flat opaque square.
8. A vacant COMMERCIAL building plot surface: isolated exact square of subtle cool grey-blue urban paving, little rectangular paving stones with fine joints and scattered delicate wear, restrained slate blue-grey character, no high contrast. NO fencing, roads, trees, buildings, signs, markings or icons. Flat opaque square.
9. A vacant INDUSTRIAL building plot surface: isolated exact square of compact beige ochre gravel with sparse small muted grey aggregate and weathered dusty soil, occasional faint tire scuff, restrained warm amber character. NO fencing, roads, trees, buildings, signs, markings or icons. Flat opaque square.

Every tile separate, no extra objects. All squares cells 5-9 occupy 86% width and height of their cell with clean axis aligned edges, all strips cells1-4 have matching registration and top/bottom edges. Render exquisite material microdetail, but avoid exaggerated thick outlines, noise clutter, and visual objects.
preparation: Existing prepare-terrain-atlas.py lossless registration; build-world-atlases.py isolated premultiplied LOD packing.
projection: Flat orthographic material surfaces. Renderer projects ground once.
